question: Will Maykel 'Osorbo' Castillo Pérez have left Cuba by September 19, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Status quo is continued imprisonment, and the horizon is only 10 days (2026-09-10 to 2026-09-19). Reference class: ~12 consecutive 10-day windows since the May 2026 exile offer, none containing a departure (Laplace ~7%). Adjust down: the regime reportedly revoked the exile offer, his sentence runs to 2030 so there is no sentence-expiry trigger (the mechanism that actually freed Otero Alcantara on July 9), the U.S. parole has sat unused ~7 weeks, and his own late-August statement is that 'the regime doesn't want me there.' Cuba's 2026 release waves explicitly excluded high-profile critics (HRW, April 2026). Adjust up slightly: high-visibility U.S. pressure (Assistant Secretary Segura's Aug 20 demand), an already-approved parole, and the fact that Cuban exile operations happen abruptly with no public warning. The Otero template took ~11 days from prison extraction to Miami, and no extraction has been reported as of today, so most YES paths would already be visible. Evidence after Aug 28 is thin (no September reporting found either way), which argues for staying near the base rate rather than moving far from it; I sit modestly below it. No prediction market prices this event.
calls.reference_class: 10-day windows since the May 2026 exile-or-prison offer in which a stalled, high-profile Cuban political prisoner with pending exile arrangements physically departed Cuba
